svg.text: Code alone answers the vector drawings 99.4% right; raster floor plans reach 87%, and counting
a drawn symbol needs no model call
Where the solution stands on the Stoa dataset, measured 14 November 2026. Scored with the dataset's rules: counts exact; areas, lengths and volumes within 2%.

questions without a numeric answer counted as not right
Who answers a raster question, and what it costs in hosted vision-model calls
The same 200 held-out drawings and 1,781 questions for every row. The detectors need no hosted model.

By kind of question: the detectors make the difference on drawn symbols; windows and doors are where errors remain
Bar: share of the questions of that kind answered with exactly the right count, on the same 200 held-out drawings. The figure at the bar is that count.
default: detectors for symbols, vision model for room types
the default counts them with the detectors: no model call
Still open: windows 97 of 200 and doors 119 of 156. A bigger detector and gentler
augmentation did not move them: see docs/training-history.png.
the default takes them from the one vision reading per drawing
Raster figures come from 200 drawings held out of detector training. The vector parts are measured on every question.
